subject: SOC 2 Type II — access matrix, bridge letter options, and one-line reply bundle
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <security@acme-corp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Northbridge Audit Team <audits@northbridge.com>
Date: 2025-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II request and audit period clarifications

Hi Jonas,

We're kicking off our vendor assurance work for Q4 product launch and need to request Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report and related artifacts. The auditor (Northbridge) asked for: 

- The Type II report covering an audit period that includes 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30 (please confirm coverage).
- A bridge letter if the most recent report does not fully cover that period.
- High-level evidence samples for: user access reviews, change control, and backup verification (redacted is fine).
- Preferred secure transfer mechanism (S3 presigned link, secure Drive folder, or vendor portal).

Can you confirm what you can provide, approximate timelines, and if Redwood has a standard bridge letter? Also please advise on redaction best practices for logs/sample screenshots.

If helpful, the auditor prefers presigned S3 with a 7-day TTL and a short manifest (csv) describing file contents.

Thanks,
Lina Gomez
Director, Information Security
Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

[Note: auditor cc'd for visibility. Attachment: acme-request-checklist.xlsx (referenced by Lina)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Northbridge Audit Team <audits@northbridge.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request and audit period clarifications

Hi Lina — thanks for the details and the checklist. Quick summary from our side and proposed next steps: 

1) Report coverage: Our most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers 2024-05-01 through 2025-04-30. That does not fully include your requested end date (2025-06-30). We can provide a bridge letter to extend/assert controls posture through your requested date window — see options below.

2) Transfer options (pick one):
   - Presigned S3 (recommended): we can issue 7-day TTL presigned objects and provide a manifest CSV.
   - Secure Drive (GDrive/Shared Drive): encrypted folder, limited to specific accounts.
   - Portal upload: for very large bundles — may add 1 business day to process.

3) Minimal evidence pack we can share now (redacted where necessary):
   - Control narrative & exec summary (PDF)
   - Redacted access review sample (xls)
   - Change control ticket export (redacted csv)
   - Backup verification snapshot (log excerpt PNG)

4) Bridge letter: we maintain a standard bridge-letter template. Olga (cc'd) will attach the template and a short checklist for redaction/PII handling.

Next actions: 
- Please confirm your preferred transfer method and whether S3 presigned is acceptable.
- If S3: confirm target TTL (7 days ok?) and recipient email addresses for the presigned links.
- We'll prepare a minimal bundle within 2 business days once transfer method is agreed.

One-line reply templates (quick use):
- "Presigned S3 (7d TTL) accepted. Send links to audits@northbridge.com and security@acme-corp.com."
- "We prefer Secure Drive. Please share folder invite for security@acme-corp.com."
- "Need bridge letter + minimal pack. Please send and we will review with auditor."

Happy to coordinate a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0199

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lina Gomez <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-02T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request and audit period clarifications

Hi Lina / team — Olga from Trust & Security here. Adding some technical clarifications and the artifacts we can provide as part of the "minimal evidence pack":

Minimal artifact list (we'll redact accounts/IPs where needed):
- SOC 2 Type II report PDF (full report)
- Bridge letter (if requested) — template attached (redwood-bridge-letter-template.docx)
- Control narratives (concise doc)
- Redacted sample access review (xls) — export from our IAM tool for a two-week sample window
- Change-control ticket export (CSV) — includes ticket ids, summary, approver initials (redacted names if requested)
- Backup job result snapshot (PNG) and a short runbook excerpt (txt)
- Telemetry sampling notes (one-page) showing where logs were sampled and redaction approach

Redaction guidance: 
- Remove full usernames (replace with user-####), redact IPs (IP-REDACTED), and remove any customer PII.
- For screenshots, crop to show process steps without identifiable data.

Transfer and delivery timeline: 
- If presigned S3 is chosen and recipient list is confirmed, we can generate the minimal pack and upload within 48 hours.
- For full audit packages or additional extracts (e.g., 12-month ticket history), allow 5 business days.

Attached: redwood-bridge-letter-template.docx; soc2-evidence-minimal-pack.xlsx (manifest with recommended filenames).

One-line reply templates we recommend sharing with your procurement/audit team: 
- "Accept S3 presigned links (7d TTL). Send links to [auditor email] and [sec email]."
- "Please redact usernames and IPs per vendor guidance; accept the manifest format attached."
- "We need a bridge letter confirming control coverage through 2025-06-30. Send bridge letter as PDF."

If you want a short pre-signed example with placeholder files, I can generate that today for review.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-bridge-letter-template.docx; soc2-evidence-minimal-pack.xlsx

From: Lina Gomez <security@acme-corp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Northbridge Audit Team <audits@northbridge.com>
Date: 2025-06-03T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request and audit period clarifications

Hi Jonas / Olga — thanks for the quick responses and the draft attachments.

We accept presigned S3 with a 7-day TTL. Please send links to audits@northbridge.com and security@acme-corp.com.

We also confirm we need a bridge letter covering 2025-05-01 through 2025-06-30 (to bridge the gap). Please: 
- Provide the bridge letter as a signed PDF.
- Include the minimal evidence pack you outlined (redaction guidance applied).

If possible, set the presigned objects to expire at 11:59PM UTC on the 7th day and include a manifest CSV with filename, size, and short description.

One-liners we'll use internally if helpful: 
- "Presigned S3 (7d TTL) — links to audits@northbridge.com + security@acme-corp.com accepted."
- "Bridge letter PDF + minimal evidence pack received and redacted as requested."

Next: we'll wait for the S3 links and the bridge letter PDF. If there are any issues with the TTL or file naming, ping me directly.

Regards,
Lina Gomez
Director, Information Security
Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com
